description: Ask a person at TrueRent to follow up. TrueRent helps companies get more value out of the way they already rent equipment. Collects company name, contact name, email and what they rent (metro optional). Intake only: no invoices, rates or other company data. A person reads every request and replies by email. This tool does not create an account or hand back any link. If the user wants a demo: they give us one of their real digital invoices and we go through it live with them. Confirm the details with the user before calling.

contact_name.description: Who TrueRent should address the reply to.

email.description: Where TrueRent should send the follow up.

metro.description: Optional. City or metro area. Helps route the follow up.

what_they_rent.description: What equipment they rent, e.g. skid steers, boom lifts, excavators, dumpsters.

name: request_follow_up
